q.sw: Pasipoti niliyolipia ni mali yangu binafsi?
q.en: What is a passport, and who owns it?

aliases: Pasipoti niliyolipia ni mali yangu binafsi?

sw.text: Pasipoti ni mali ya Serikali ya Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania. Mwenye kupewa ana wajibu wa kuitumia na kuitunza kwa mujibu wa sheria. Kuilipia hakumpi ruhusa ya kuibadilisha, kumkabidhi asiyehusika au kuitumia kinyume cha masharti.

q.sw: Pasipoti ya kielektroniki (e-Passport) ni nini?
q.en: What is the electronic passport (e-Passport)?

sw.text: Ni pasipoti yenye kifaa maalum cha kielektroniki (micro-chip) kinachohifadhi taarifa za mwenye pasipoti. Inakidhi viwango vya kimataifa, inafanana na pasipoti za nchi za Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki, na inasomeka kwenye mifumo ya viwanja vya ndege na mipakani duniani kote. Ada yake ni Tsh 150,000.
sw.note: Kama una pasipoti ya zamani (isiyo ya kielektroniki), omba mpya ukichagua aina ya ombi PASIPOTI IMEJAA/IMEISHA MUDA/KUPATA PASIPOTI NYINGINE.

en.text: A passport with an electronic micro-chip storing the holder's data. It meets international standards, matches EAC passports in appearance and is readable by airport and border systems worldwide. Fee: Tsh 150,000.
en.note: If you hold an old (non-electronic) passport, apply choosing FULL/EXPIRED/ANOTHER PASSPORT.

q.sw: Viambatisho vya ziada kulingana na aina ya safari ni vipi?
q.en: Extra documents by type of trip?

sw.text: Pamoja na viambatisho vya msingi, ambatisha kulingana na safari yako:
list: Safari binafsi: uthibitisho wa shughuli zako, barua ya mwaliko (na nakala ya pasipoti ya mwalikaji).
Ajira nje ya nchi: barua ya ajira au mkataba wa kazi, na vyeti vya taaluma.
Masomo: barua ya kukubaliwa chuoni, vyeti vya elimu, barua ya mfadhili au uthibitisho wa ada; idhini ya mwajiri au ya mzazi (chini ya miaka 18).
Matibabu: barua ya daktari aliyesajiliwa au idhini ya Wizara ya Afya.
Kikazi (rasmi): barua ya mwajiri na kitambulisho cha kazi.
Biashara: leseni ya biashara, TIN na barua ya Afisa Mtendaji wa Kata/Sheha.
Michezo: barua ya chama cha michezo kilichosajiliwa (mf. TFF/ZFA) na barua ya mwaliko.
Kidini: barua ya mwaliko na barua ya taasisi ya dini inayohusika.
Ubaharia: mkataba wa kazi, kitabu cha ubaharia (discharge book), vyeti vya ujuzi na barua ya chama cha mabaharia.

en.text: In addition to the basic documents, attach according to your trip:
list: Private trip: proof of activities, invitation letter (and inviter's passport copy).
Employment abroad: offer letter/contract and academic certificates.
Study: admission letter, certificates, sponsor letter or proof of fees; employer or parent consent (under 18).
Medical: letter from a registered doctor or Ministry of Health authority.
Official trip: employer letter and work ID.
Business: business licence, TIN and a letter from the Ward Executive Officer/Sheha.
Sports: letter from a registered sports association (e.g. TFF/ZFA) and invitation.
Religious: invitation and a letter from the religious organisation.
Seaman: employment contract, discharge book, certificates and seamen union letter.

q.sw: Mambo gani ya kuzingatia wakati wa kujaza fomu ya pasipoti?
q.en: Tips for filling the passport form?

list: Hakikisha una viambatisho vyote kabla ya kuanza.
Jaza taarifa kwa herufi kubwa, kwa usahihi na ukamilifu.
Majina yafanane na yaliyo kwenye cheti/kiapo cha kuzaliwa. Yakitofautiana utahitaji kiapo au hati ya kubadili jina (Deed Poll).
Kosa ukiliona baada ya kuchapisha fomu, lirekebishe kwa kalamu ya wino na usaini pembeni yake.
Kiapo cha kuzaliwa kiwe na stempu ya ushuru kama Sheria ya Viapo inavyoelekeza.
Pasipoti ikichapishwa na makosa kutokana na taarifa zako, utajaza fomu upya na kulipa ada kamili (Tsh 150,000).
Have all documents ready before you start.
Fill in details in capital letters, accurately and completely.
Names must match your birth certificate/affidavit; if they differ you need an affidavit or Deed Poll.
If you spot an error after printing, correct it in ink and sign beside it.
An affidavit of birth must carry the revenue stamp required by law.
If the passport is printed with errors from your own details, you must re-apply and pay the full fee (Tsh 150,000).

q.sw: Kuna aina gani za pasipoti?
q.en: What types of passports are there?

sw.text: Idara ya Uhamiaji inatoa aina tatu za pasipoti:
list: Pasipoti ya Kawaida (rangi ya bluu) — kwa raia yeyote wa Tanzania; inadumu miaka 10.
Pasipoti ya Kiutumishi (rangi ya kijani) — kwa viongozi wa Serikali waliotajwa kwenye Sheria ya Pasipoti; inadumu miaka 5; inahitaji barua ya utambulisho kutoka Utumishi.
Pasipoti ya Kidiplomasia (rangi nyekundu) — kwa viongozi wenye hadhi maalum; inadumu miaka 5; inahitaji barua ya Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje.
sw.note: Zote zinatumika kwenda nchi zote duniani. Mwenye pasipoti ya kiutumishi au kidiplomasia akistaafu au kuondoka kwenye nafasi hiyo, anatakiwa kuirudisha Uhamiaji na kutumia pasipoti ya kawaida.

en.text: The Immigration Department issues three passport types:
list: Ordinary (blue) — any Tanzanian citizen; valid 10 years.
Service (green) — government officials listed in the Passports Act; valid 5 years; needs an introduction letter from the Public Service office.
Diplomatic (red) — officials with special status; valid 5 years; needs a Ministry of Foreign Affairs letter.
en.note: All are valid for all countries. Holders of service/diplomatic passports must return them when they leave the position and use an ordinary passport.

q.sw: Pasipoti inaweza kufutwa kwa sababu gani?
q.en: When can a passport be revoked?

sw.text: Pasipoti ni mali ya Serikali. Kamishna Jenerali wa Uhamiaji anaweza kuifuta pale ambapo:
list: Mwenye pasipoti amemruhusu mtu mwingine kuitumia.
Amefukuzwa au kurejeshwa nchini kwa gharama za Serikali.
Amekoma kuwa raia wa Tanzania.
Anajihusisha na dawa za kulevya, utakatishaji fedha, usafirishaji haramu wa binadamu, ugaidi au miamala mingine haramu.
Ni kwa maslahi au usalama wa Taifa.

en.text: A passport is Government property. The Commissioner General may revoke it where:
list: The holder allows another person to use it.
The holder was deported or repatriated at Government expense.
The holder has ceased to be a Tanzanian citizen.
The holder engages in drug trafficking, money laundering, migrant smuggling, terrorism or other illegal dealings.
It is in the national interest or for national security.

en.text: Apply only through the official Immigration website (www.immigration.go.tz → APPLY NOW / e-Services), not other links or agents. Every applicant is deemed to have read and accepted the Disclaimer at the end of the application before paying.

q.sw: Kuna aina gani za visa?
q.en: What types of visas are there?

sw.text: Tanzania inatoa visa za aina sita kulingana na madhumuni ya safari:
list: Ordinary Visa — utalii, kutembelea, mikutano, matibabu; kuingia mara moja, hadi miezi 3.
Business Visa — kazi za muda mfupi (kufunga/kutengeneza mitambo, mafunzo, ukaguzi wa hesabu); hadi siku 90.
Multiple Entry Visa — wanaohitaji kuingia mara kwa mara; hadi miezi 12 (lazima kutoka nchini angalau kila miezi 3).
Student Visa — masomo katika taasisi zinazotambulika.
Transit Visa — kupita Tanzania kwenda nchi nyingine; hadi siku 7.
Gratis (Diplomatic) Visa — wenye pasipoti za kidiplomasia/kiutumishi walio kazini rasmi, bila malipo.

en.text: Tanzania issues six visa types depending on the purpose of travel:
list: Ordinary Visa — tourism, visits, conferences, treatment; single entry, up to 3 months.
Business Visa — short assignments (machine repair, training, auditing); up to 90 days.
Multiple Entry Visa — frequent visitors; up to 12 months (must leave at least every 3 months).
Student Visa — study at recognised institutions.
Transit Visa — passing through to another country; up to 7 days.
Gratis (Diplomatic) Visa — diplomatic/service passport holders on official duty, free of charge.

q.sw: Ordinary Visa ni nini na masharti yake?
q.en: Which visa should I choose for a holiday?

aliases: Which visa should I choose for a holiday?

en.text: An Ordinary Visa is the usual category for tourism where a visa is required, except that USA passport holders travelling for tourism are directed to the Multiple Visa category. en.text: It covers eligible short-term assignments such as technical repairs, short training, professional assignments or investment preparation, within the authorised conditions. q.sw: Student Visa inapatikanaje?
q.en: How do I get a Student Visa?

sw.text: Hutolewa kwa mgeni anayekuja kusoma. Huombwa mtandaoni mwanafunzi akiwa bado nje ya Tanzania, akiwa amepata udahili kwenye chuo au taasisi inayotambulika.
list: Barua ya udahili na hati ya usajili wa taasisi viunganishwe kwenye PDF moja na kupakiwa.
Ada: USD 50 (miezi 3), USD 250 (hadi miaka 2), USD 300 (watafiti), USD 550 (PhD).
Vyuo vya kufundisha lugha haviruhusiwi kutoa visa ya miaka 2 — wanaojifunza lugha huomba visa ya miezi 3 tu.
sw.note: Aliyeshaingia nchini anaomba Student Pass, si Student Visa.

en.text: For foreigners coming to study. Apply online while still outside Tanzania, with admission to a recognised institution.
list: Admission letter and the institution's registration must be combined into one PDF and uploaded.
Fees: USD 50 (3 months), USD 250 (up to 2 years), USD 300 (researchers), USD 550 (PhD).
Language schools cannot offer 2-year validity — language students apply for a 3-month visa only.
en.note: Anyone already in the country applies for a Student Pass, not a Student Visa.

q.sw: Transit Visa ni nini?
q.en: Can a Transit Visa be used for a holiday?

aliases: Can a Transit Visa be used for a holiday?

en.text: No. Transit Visa is for passing through Tanzania to another country, not for tourism. The e-Library guidelines provide for a period not exceeding seven days and require evidence of onward travel and, where applicable, permission to enter the destination country.

q.en: Why must USA passport holders select Multiple Visa for tourism?

q.sw: Kibali cha Ukaazi (Residence Permit) ni nini na nani anakihitaji?
q.en: What is a Residence Permit and who needs one?

sw.text: Ni kibali kinachomruhusu mgeni kuishi Tanzania kwa ajili ya uwekezaji, biashara, ajira au shughuli nyingine halali. Mambo muhimu:
list: Waombaji ni kampuni/taasisi zilizosajiliwa Tanzania, au watu binafsi (wastaafu, wanaotibiwa, watafiti, wenye kesi mahakamani, wanunuzi wa nyumba n.k.).
Maombi yawasilishwe na kuidhinishwa mgeni akiwa bado nje ya Tanzania.
Wengi wanatakiwa kwanza kupata Kibali cha Kazi (Work Permit) kutoka kwa Kamishna wa Kazi — isipokuwa watafiti, wastaafu na wanaohudhuria kesi.
Mamlaka ya kutoa kibali ni ya Kamishna Jenerali wa Uhamiaji; asiyeridhika na uamuzi anaweza kukata rufaa kwa Waziri wa Mambo ya Ndani akiwa nje ya nchi.

en.text: A permit allowing a foreigner to live in Tanzania for investment, business, employment or other lawful activity. Key points:
list: Applicants are companies/institutions registered in Tanzania, or individuals (retirees, patients, researchers, court parties, real-estate buyers, etc.).
Applications must be lodged and approved while the foreigner is still outside Tanzania.
Most need a Work Permit from the Labour Commissioner first — except researchers, retirees and court attendees.
The Commissioner General of Immigration issues permits; appeals go to the Minister for Home Affairs while outside the country.

q.sw: Kuna madaraja gani ya vibali vya ukaazi?
q.en: What classes of residence permits are there?

sw.text: Kuna madaraja matatu:
list: Class A — wawekezaji waliojiajiri (mf. wawekezaji wa kawaida, Diaspora, wasanii wawekezaji, wakimbizi wawekezaji).
Class B — wageni walioajiriwa na kampuni au taasisi, wenye ujuzi adimu usiopatikana kwa urahisi nchini.

Class C — makundi mengine: watafiti, wastaafu (miaka 55+), wamisionari, wanaojitolea, wanafunzi wa mafunzo kwa vitendo (intern), wanaotibiwa, waajiriwa wa NGO, wenye kesi mahakamani, wanunuzi wa nyumba, wanaohitimisha shughuli (winding up) n.k.

en.text: There are three classes:
list: Class A — self-employed investors (general, Diaspora, artist and refugee investors).
Class B — employees of companies/institutions with skills not readily available locally.
Class C — others: researchers, retirees (55+), missionaries, volunteers, interns, patients, NGO employees, court parties, real-estate buyers, winding-up of affairs, etc.

q.sw: Kibali cha ukaazi kinadumu muda gani?
q.en: How long is a residence permit valid?

sw.text: Kibali cha daraja lolote hakizidi miaka 2 na kinaweza kuhuishwa. Muda halisi hutegemea mkataba wa ajira, muda wa leseni ya bodi ya taaluma husika, na muda wa Kibali cha Kazi.

en.text: Any class is valid for a maximum of 2 years and may be renewed. The actual period depends on the employment contract, the professional board licence and the Work Permit.

q.sw: Hali za utoaji (FG, RT, SG, RPL, RG1, RG2) zina maana gani?
q.en: What do issuance statuses (FG, RT, SG, RPL, RG1, RG2) mean?

list: FG (First Grant) — ombi la kwanza.
RT (Returnee) — anarejea kwenye taasisi yake ya awali baada ya kutokuwepo zaidi ya miaka 3.
SG (Second Grant) — anabadilisha daraja ndani ya taasisi ileile (mf. B kwenda A).
RPL (Replacement) — kuhuisha kibali kilichoisha muda.
RG1 (Re-Grant 1) — kuhamia taasisi nyingine kwa daraja lilelile.
RG2 (Re-Grant 2) — kuhamia taasisi nyingine kwa daraja tofauti.
FG (First Grant) — first application.
RT (Returnee) — rejoining the previous institution after more than 3 years away.
SG (Second Grant) — changing class in the same institution (e.g. B to A).
RPL (Replacement) — renewal after expiry.
RG1 — moving to another institution in the same class.
RG2 — moving to another institution in a different class.

q.sw: Nani anaomba kibali cha ukaazi — mimi au mwajiri?
q.en: Who applies for the permit — me or my employer?

list: Kwa ajira na uwekezaji: kampuni, taasisi au mwajiri aliyesajiliwa Tanzania ndiye huomba kwa niaba ya mgeni.
Kwa makundi binafsi (mstaafu, anayetibiwa, mtafiti, mwenye kesi mahakamani, mnunuzi wa nyumba, intern): mhusika au taasisi mwenyeji huomba.
Maombi hufanywa mtandaoni kupitia akaunti ya mfumo wa vibali.
For employment and investment: the company, institution or employer registered in Tanzania applies on the foreigner's behalf.
For individual categories (retirees, patients, researchers, court parties, real-estate buyers, interns): the person or host institution applies.
Applications are made online through a permit system account.

q.sw: Niko tayari Tanzania — naweza kuomba kibali cha ukaazi?
q.en: I am already in Tanzania — can I apply for a permit?

sw.text: Kwa kawaida hapana: maombi yanapaswa kuwasilishwa na kuidhinishwa ukiwa bado nje ya nchi. Isipokuwa:
list: Kuhuisha kibali (renewal) ukiwa tayari mkaazi.
Wastaafu na wanaohitimisha shughuli (winding up) wa Class C.
Mwajiri anayeomba kibali cha kwanza mgeni akiwa tayari nchini anaweza kutozwa ada ya Special Pass juu ya ada ya kibali.
sw.note: Kwa hali nyingine maalum, wasiliana na Idara kupitia info@immigration.go.tz.

en.text: Normally no: applications must be lodged and approved while you are still abroad. Exceptions:
list: Renewals while already resident.
Class C retirees and winding-up cases.
An employer applying for a first grant while the foreigner is already in the country may pay a Special Pass fee on top.
en.note: For other special cases, contact info@immigration.go.tz.

q.sw: Ombi la kibali likikataliwa, nifanye nini?

en.text: The Commissioner General of Immigration issues permits. An applicant dissatisfied with the decision may appeal to the Minister for Home Affairs while outside the country.

q.sw: Ninaombaje kibali cha ukaazi mtandaoni?
q.en: How do I apply for a residence permit online?

aliases: jinsi ya kuomba kibali cha kuishi
how to apply for a residence permit

sw.text: Kwa kawaida kibali huombwa na kampuni au mwajiri mgeni akiwa bado nje ya nchi.
steps: Pata kwanza Kibali cha Kazi kutoka kwa Kamishna wa Kazi (kazi.go.tz), pale kinapohitajika.
Fungua immigration.go.tz → e-Services → Residence Permit, na soma mwongozo wa vibali.
Fungua akaunti (barua pepe, simu, anwani na nenosiri).
Jaza fomu, ambatisha nyaraka zote na wasilisha.
Ombi likiidhinishwa kwa malipo, lipa ndani ya siku 60 — vinginevyo ombi hufutwa lenyewe.
Baada ya malipo utapokea Enrolment Notification: fika ofisi ya Uhamiaji kwa alama za vidole na picha.
Kibali hutolewa ndani ya wiki moja; hukichukua Ofisi ya Uhamiaji ya Mkoa, Makao Makuu, Afisi Kuu Zanzibar, TIC, EPZA au ZIPA.
sw.note: Mwajiri anayeomba kibali cha kwanza mgeni akiwa tayari nchini anaweza kutozwa ada ya Special Pass juu ya ada ya kibali. Waliosajiliwa TIC, EPZA au ZIPA wanaweza kuwasilisha kupitia madirisha yao.

en.text: Normally the company/employer applies while the foreigner is still abroad.
steps: First obtain a Work Permit from the Labour Commissioner (kazi.go.tz) where required.
Open immigration.go.tz → e-Services → Residence Permit and read the guidelines.
Create an account (email, phone, address and password).
Fill the form, attach all documents and submit.
When approved for payment, pay within 60 days — otherwise the application is deleted automatically.
After payment you receive an Enrolment Notification: visit an immigration office for fingerprints and photo.
The permit is issued within a week and collected at the Regional office, Headquarters, Zanzibar Head Office, TIC, EPZA or ZIPA.
en.note: An employer applying for a first grant while the foreigner is already in the country may pay a Special Pass fee on top. TIC, EPZA and ZIPA registrants may submit through their windows.

q.sw: Ada za vibali vya ukaazi ni kiasi gani?
q.en: How much are residence permit fees?

sw.text: Ada (kwa USD) hutegemea daraja na kundi; raia wa Afrika Mashariki (EAC) na Diaspora hupata punguzo:
list: Class A: Mwekezaji wa kawaida 3,000 (EAC 1,500); Msanii mwekezaji 1,000 (EAC 500); Diaspora 1,000; Mkimbizi mwekezaji 1,500.
Class B: Ajira ya kawaida 2,000 (EAC 500); Diaspora 500; Kibali cha muda mfupi (hadi miezi 6) 500; Wakimbizi 500.

Class C: Watafiti, wastaafu, NGO, wenye kesi, wasanii, wanunuzi wa nyumba na wengineo 500 (EAC 250); Wamisionari, wanaojitolea, wanaotibiwa, intern na wanaohitimisha shughuli 200 (EAC 100); Wakimbizi — bila malipo.
sw.note: Kila mwombaji na mtegemezi hulipia pia Re-entry Pass ya USD 50 (USD 250 kwa kibali cha muda mfupi Class B).

en.text: Fees (USD) depend on class and category; EAC citizens and Diaspora get reductions:
list: Class A: general investor 3,000 (EAC 1,500); artist investor 1,000 (EAC 500); Diaspora 1,000; refugee investor 1,500.
Class B: standard employment 2,000 (EAC 500); Diaspora 500; short-term (up to 6 months) 500; refugees 500.
Class C: researchers, retirees, NGO, court parties, artists, real-estate buyers and others 500 (EAC 250); missionaries, volunteers, patients, interns and winding-up 200 (EAC 100); refugees — free.
en.note: Each applicant and dependant also pays a Re-entry Pass of USD 50 (USD 250 for short-term Class B).

q.sw: Ninafuatiliaje ombi la kibali cha ukaazi?
q.en: How do I track my residence permit application?

sw.text: Ingia kwenye akaunti yako ya maombi. Utaona:
list: Submitted Application Status — hali ya ombi.
Pending Application — hoja au nyaraka zinazokosekana (utaarifiwa pia kwa barua pepe). Jibu hoja au ambatisha nyaraka ili ombi liendelee.
Pending Payment — maelekezo ya malipo (lipa ndani ya siku 60).

en.text: Sign in to your application account. You will see:
list: Submitted Application Status — progress.
Pending Application — queries or missing documents (also notified by email). Respond so processing continues.
Pending Payment — payment instructions (pay within 60 days).

q.sw: Exemption Certificate ni nini?
q.en: What is an Exemption Certificate?

sw.text: Ni hati ya ukaazi isiyolipiwa ada, inayotolewa kwa:
list: Wanadiplomasia pamoja na wake/waume na watoto wao wategemezi.
Wataalamu wa kigeni walio kwenye miradi ya Serikali.
Wanafunzi kutoka nchi za Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki (EAC).
sw.note: Viambatisho: barua ya taasisi, fomu iliyojazwa, barua ya Utumishi (si kwa wanafunzi wa EAC), msamaha wa Kibali cha Kazi, nakala ya pasipoti, picha, CV na vyeti. Wanafunzi wa EAC huongeza barua ya udahili ya chuo.

en.text: A fee-free residence document issued to:
list: Diplomats and their spouses and dependent children.
Foreign experts on Government projects.
Students from East African Community (EAC) states.
en.note: Documents: institution letter, completed form, Public Service letter (not for EAC students), Work Permit exemption, passport copy, photos, CV and certificates. EAC students add the admission letter.

q.sw: Kibali cha ukaazi kinachukuliwa wapi na baada ya muda gani?
q.en: Where and when do I collect my permit?

sw.text: Baada ya malipo na kuchukuliwa alama za vidole na picha, kibali hushughulikiwa na kutolewa ndani ya wiki moja. Hukichukua Ofisi ya Uhamiaji ya Mkoa ambapo kampuni ipo, Uhamiaji Makao Makuu, Afisi Kuu Zanzibar, au kupitia TIC, EPZA au ZIPA kulingana na ulikowasilisha.

en.text: After payment and fingerprint/photo enrolment, the permit is processed and issued within a week. Collect it at the Regional Immigration Office where the company is located, Immigration Headquarters, the Zanzibar Head Office, or through TIC, EPZA or ZIPA as applicable.

q.sw: Pasi (Pass) ni nini na zipo za aina gani?
q.en: What is a Pass and what types exist?

sw.text: Pasi ni hadhi ya kiuhamiaji inayompa mgeni ruhusa ya kuingia na kukaa nchini kwa madhumuni maalum, tofauti na kibali cha ukaazi. Muda wake hauzidi miaka 2. Aina kuu:
list: Dependant Pass — wategemezi wa raia au mkaazi.
Student Pass — wanafunzi walio nchini.
Business Pass — kazi za muda mfupi kwa raia wa nchi zisizohitaji visa.
Visitor's Pass — wageni kutoka nchi zisizohitaji visa.
Re-entry Pass — wakaazi wanaosafiri na kurudi.
In-Transit Pass — kupita nchini hadi siku 7.
Landing Pass — wafanyakazi wa meli.
Interim Pass — kusubiri uamuzi au kupata kibali.
Special Pass (EAC) — raia wa EAC hadi siku 90.
Migrant Pass na Seasonal Migrant Pass — wahamiaji wa muda mrefu na wa msimu.
sw.note: Viambatisho vya jumla: nakala ya pasipoti halali, barua ya taasisi, pasi ya awali (ukihuisha) na ada husika. Huombwa mtandaoni kupitia e-Pass.

en.text: A Pass is an immigration status allowing a foreigner to enter and stay for a specific purpose, distinct from a residence permit. Maximum validity is 2 years. Main types:
list: Dependant Pass — dependants of citizens or residents.
Student Pass — students already in the country.
Business Pass — short assignments for visa-exempt nationals.
Visitor's Pass — visitors from visa-exempt countries.
Re-entry Pass — residents travelling and returning.
In-Transit Pass — passing through up to 7 days.
Landing Pass — ship crew.
Interim Pass — awaiting a decision or permit.
Special Pass (EAC) — EAC nationals up to 90 days.
Migrant Pass and Seasonal Migrant Pass — long-term and seasonal migrants.
en.note: General documents: valid passport copy, institution letter, previous pass (renewal) and the fee. Apply online via e-Pass.

q.sw: Ninaombaje pasi, na inadumu muda gani?
q.en: How do I apply for a pass, and how long is it valid?

steps: Omba mtandaoni kupitia e-Pass (immigration.go.tz → e-Services → Pass).
Ambatisha nakala ya pasipoti halali, barua ya taasisi husika na viambatisho maalum vya aina ya pasi.
Kwa kuhuisha, ambatisha pasi ya awali.
Lipa ada husika ya aina ya pasi.
sw.note: Muda wa pasi yoyote hauzidi miaka 2. Re-entry Pass hudumu kwa muda wa kibali au pasi uliyonayo.

steps: Apply online via e-Pass (immigration.go.tz → e-Services → Pass).
Attach a valid passport copy, the institution's letter and the pass-specific documents.
For renewal, attach the previous pass.
Pay the relevant fee.
en.note: No pass is valid for more than 2 years. A Re-entry Pass lasts as long as your current permit or pass.

q.sw: Dependant Pass inapatikanaje?
q.en: Does a Dependant Pass allow my spouse to work?

aliases: Does a Dependant Pass allow my spouse to work?

en.text: Do not treat dependant status as permission to work. A person wishing to take employment must obtain the applicable authorisation for that activity. Marriage or dependence alone does not replace work and residence requirements.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Do not treat dependant status as permission to work. A person wishing to take employment must obtain the applicable authorisation for that activity. Marriage or dependence alone does not replace work and residence requirements.

q.sw: Student Pass inapatikanaje?
q.en: How do I get a Student Pass?

sw.text: Kuna aina mbili:
list: Student Pass I — wanafunzi wa taasisi zinazotambulika, wakiwemo watoto wa wakaazi waliofikia umri wa utu uzima. Viambatisho: usajili wa taasisi, ushahidi wa ufadhili, ushahidi wa usajili (enrolment), barua ya udahili na joining instructions. Ada USD 200 (EAC bure).

Student Pass II — watoto wa wakaazi walio chini ya umri wa utu uzima wasioandikwa kwenye vibali vya wazazi (chekechea hadi elimu ya juu). Viambatisho: barua ya udahili, ufadhili, idhini ya mzazi/mlezi, kibali cha mzazi, vyeti vya kuzaliwa na pasipoti ya mzazi. Ada USD 100 (EAC bure).
sw.note: Nakala zote zithibitishwe. Vyuo vya lugha haviruhusiwi kutoa pasi ya miaka 2.

en.text: There are two types:
list: Student Pass I — students at approved institutions, including adult children of residents. Documents: institution registration, sponsorship, enrolment evidence, admission letter and joining instructions. Fee USD 200 (EAC free).

Student Pass II — minor children of residents not endorsed on their parents' permits (kindergarten to higher learning). Documents: admission letter, sponsorship, parent/guardian consent, parent's permit, birth certificates and parent's passport. Fee USD 100 (EAC free).
en.note: All copies must be certified. Language schools cannot offer 2-year validity.

q.sw: Business Pass ni nini?
q.en: What is a Business Pass?

sw.text: Hutolewa kwa raia wa nchi zisizohitaji visa kuingia Tanzania, kwa kazi maalum za muda mfupi — mf. ukaguzi wa hesabu, kutengeneza mitambo, upembuzi yakinifu, kuanzisha mawasiliano ya kibiashara au maandalizi ya uwekezaji. Ada ni USD 200 (EAC USD 100).

en.text: Issued to nationals of visa-exempt countries for short assignments — e.g. auditing, machine repair, feasibility studies, business contacts or investment start-up. Fee USD 200 (EAC USD 100).

q.sw: Visitor's Pass ni nini?
q.en: What is a Visitor's Pass?

sw.text: Hutolewa ukifika nchini kwa wageni kutoka nchi zisizohitaji visa, kwa ajili ya kutembelea ndugu/marafiki, mapumziko, kusafiri, mikutano, matibabu, kuhudhuria mahakama au sababu nyingine za msingi.
sw.note: Mwenye Visitor's Pass haruhusiwi kufanya ajira, biashara wala kazi ya kitaaluma.

en.text: Issued on arrival to visitors from visa-exempt countries for visiting friends/relatives, holidays, travel, meetings, treatment, appearing in court or other sufficient reasons.
en.note: A Visitor's Pass holder may not engage in employment, trade, business or professional activity.

q.sw: Re-entry Pass ni nini?
q.en: What is a Re-entry Pass?

sw.text: Humwezesha mgeni mkaazi wa Tanzania kusafiri nje na kurudi bila kupoteza hadhi yake ya ukaazi. Inadumu kwa muda wa kibali au pasi aliyonayo. Kwa wenye vibali vya ukaazi, ada yake ni USD 50 kwa kila mwombaji na mtegemezi.

en.text: Enables a foreign resident to travel abroad and return without losing residence status. Valid for the duration of the current permit or pass. For permit holders the fee is USD 50 per applicant and dependant.

q.sw: In-Transit Pass na Landing Pass ni nini?
q.en: What are the In-Transit and Landing Passes?

list: In-Transit Pass: kwa mgeni anayepita Tanzania kwenda nchi nyingine; haizidi siku 7.
Landing Pass: kwa mfanyakazi wa meli iliyowasili kwa bahari au ziwa katika safari isiyokatika, anayetaka kushuka nchi kavu kutembea au kwa sababu nyingine, kwa muda ambao meli iko bandarini.
In-Transit Pass: for a foreigner passing through Tanzania to another country; up to 7 days.
Landing Pass: for a crew member of a ship arriving by sea or lake on a continuous journey who wishes to go ashore while the ship is in port.

q.sw: Interim Pass na Special Pass ya EAC ni nini?
q.en: What are the Interim Pass and EAC Special Pass?

list: Interim Pass: humpa mgeni muda wa kufanyiwa uchunguzi ili kubaini kama anastahili kibali cha ukaazi, au kumpa nafasi ya kuomba na kupata kibali au pasi nyingine. Ada USD 600.
Special Pass (EAC): kwa raia wa nchi wanachama wa Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki waliopata ajira au wanaotaka kufanya biashara, taaluma au kazi ya muda kwa kipindi kisichozidi siku 90.
Interim Pass: gives a foreigner time for inquiry to determine eligibility for a residence permit, or a chance to apply for a permit or other pass. Fee USD 600.
Special Pass (EAC): for EAC nationals who secured employment or wish to do business, a profession or a temporary assignment for up to 90 days.

q.sw: Migrant Pass na Seasonal Migrant Pass ni nini?
q.en: What are the Migrant and Seasonal Migrant Passes?

list: Migrant Pass: kwa watu wenye asili ya Kiafrika kutoka nchi jirani walioingia Tanzania kabla ya 1972 na wanaendelea kuishi bila pasipoti au utambulisho wa nchi nyingine. Hutolewa kwa miaka 2. Viambatisho: barua za mapendekezo za VEO na WEO, barua ya Afisa Uhamiaji wa Mkoa, ushahidi wa kuwepo nchini tangu 1972 na vyeti vya kuzaliwa inapohitajika. Ada Tsh 10,000.

Seasonal Migrant Pass: kwa raia wa nchi jirani wanaokuja kufanya kazi za msimu (mf. kilimo, uvuvi). Mwajiri hujisajili, hujaza fomu mtandaoni kwa ajili ya kibarua wake kwa miezi 3 au 6, huichapisha na kuiwasilisha pamoja na vielelezo Ofisi ya Uhamiaji ya Mkoa.

Migrant Pass: for people of African descent from neighbouring countries who entered Tanzania before 1972 and still live here without another country's passport or ID. Issued for 2 years. Documents: VEO and WEO recommendation letters, Regional Immigration Officer letter, evidence of presence since 1972 and birth certificates where needed. Fee Tsh 10,000.

Seasonal Migrant Pass: for nationals of neighbouring countries doing seasonal work (e.g. farming, fishing). The employer registers, applies online for the worker for 3 or 6 months, prints and submits it with documents at the Regional Immigration Office.

q.sw: Nani anaweza kuwa mtegemezi (dependant)?
q.en: Who can be a dependant?

list: Mke (wife) wa raia au mkaazi halali.
Watoto.
Ndugu wa karibu, wakiwemo wazazi (baba/mama) wa mwombaji.
sw.note: Mtoto wa kiume aliyezidi miaka 18 hastahili kuwa mtegemezi — anaweza kuhitaji Student Pass au kibali chake mwenyewe.

list: The wife of a citizen or legal resident.
Children.
Near relatives, including the applicant's parents.
en.note: A son over 18 cannot be a dependant — he may need a Student Pass or his own permit.

q.sw: Tofauti ya Student Visa na Student Pass ni ipi?
q.en: Student Visa vs Student Pass — what's the difference?

aliases: tofauti ya visa na pasi ya mwanafunzi

list: Student Visa: huombwa mtandaoni mwanafunzi akiwa bado nje ya Tanzania, kabla ya kuja kusoma.
Student Pass: kwa mwanafunzi ambaye tayari yuko nchini (pamoja na watoto wa wakaazi wanaosoma hapa).
Student Visa: applied online while the student is still outside Tanzania, before coming to study.
Student Pass: for a student already in the country (including children of residents studying here).

q.sw: Ada za pasi ni kiasi gani?
q.en: How much are pass fees?

Dependant Pass kwa mke wa kigeni wa Mtanzania: Tsh 200,000
Business Pass: USD 200 (EAC USD 100)
Interim Pass: USD 600
Student Pass I: USD 200 (EAC bure)
Student Pass II: USD 100 (EAC bure)
Migrant Pass: Tsh 10,000
Re-entry Pass (kwa wenye vibali): USD 50 kwa kila mtu
Exemption Certificate: bila malipo

Dependant Pass for a foreign wife of a Tanzanian: Tsh 200,000

Interim Pass: USD 600
Student Pass I: USD 200 (EAC free)

Re-entry Pass (permit holders): USD 50 per person

q.sw: Kuna aina gani za uraia wa Tanzania?
q.en: What types of Tanzanian citizenship are there?

sw.text: Uraia wa Tanzania unasimamiwa na Sheria ya Uraia wa Tanzania, Sura ya 357. Kuna aina tatu:
list: Uraia kwa kuzaliwa — aliyezaliwa Tanzania, na wakati wa kuzaliwa mmoja wa wazazi wake alikuwa raia.
Uraia kwa kurithi (descent) — aliyezaliwa nje ya Tanzania, na wakati wa kuzaliwa baba au mama yake alikuwa raia kwa kuzaliwa au kwa tajnisi.
Uraia wa tajnisi (naturalisation) — mgeni asiye raia kwa kuzaliwa wala kurithi anayeomba kwa Waziri na kukubaliwa.

en.text: Tanzanian citizenship is governed by the Tanzania Citizenship Act, Cap. 357. There are three types:
list: By birth — born in Tanzania with at least one parent a citizen at the time of birth.
By descent — born outside Tanzania with a father or mother who was a citizen by birth or naturalisation at the time.
By naturalisation — a foreigner who is not a citizen by birth or descent applies to the Minister and is granted citizenship.

q.sw: Mtu mwenye cheti cha kuzaliwa Tanzania ni raia bila uchunguzi mwingine?
q.en: Who is a Tanzanian citizen by birth?

aliases: Mtu mwenye cheti cha kuzaliwa Tanzania ni raia bila uchunguzi mwingine?

sw.text: Usihitimishe kwa cheti pekee. Uraia hutathminiwa kwa masharti ya sheria, taarifa za wazazi na mazingira yanayohusika. Cheti cha kuzaliwa ni nyaraka muhimu, lakini kinaweza kuhitaji kuungwa mkono na vielelezo vingine wakati wa uthibitisho wa uraia.

en.text: English translation pending review. Original answer: Usihitimishe kwa cheti pekee. Uraia hutathminiwa kwa masharti ya sheria, taarifa za wazazi na mazingira yanayohusika. Cheti cha kuzaliwa ni nyaraka muhimu, lakini kinaweza kuhitaji kuungwa mkono na vielelezo vingine wakati wa uthibitisho wa uraia.

q.sw: Mtoto kuzaliwa nje ya Tanzania kunamaanisha hawezi kuwa Mtanzania?
q.en: Is a child born abroad to a Tanzanian parent a citizen?

aliases: mtoto wa raia aliyezaliwa nje ya nchi
Mtoto kuzaliwa nje ya Tanzania kunamaanisha hawezi kuwa Mtanzania?

sw.text: Si lazima. Ustahiki unahitaji kuchunguza tarehe na mahali pa kuzaliwa pamoja na uraia wa mzazi na namna mzazi alivyoupata. Wasilisha vyeti na nyaraka husika kwa tathmini; usitoe jibu la jumla kwa kutumia mahali pa kuzaliwa pekee.

en.text: English translation pending review. Original answer: Si lazima. Ustahiki unahitaji kuchunguza tarehe na mahali pa kuzaliwa pamoja na uraia wa mzazi na namna mzazi alivyoupata. Wasilisha vyeti na nyaraka husika kwa tathmini; usitoe jibu la jumla kwa kutumia mahali pa kuzaliwa pekee.

q.sw: Kukaa Tanzania miaka kumi kunanipa uraia moja kwa moja?
q.en: What are the requirements for naturalisation?

aliases: Kukaa Tanzania miaka kumi kunanipa uraia moja kwa moja?

sw.text: Hapana. Tajnisi inahitaji maombi na kutimiza masharti. Jedwali la Pili linataja ukaazi katika miezi 12 kabla ya maombi na jumla ya angalau miaka saba katika kipindi cha miaka kumi kinachotangulia miezi hiyo 12, pamoja na masharti mengine. Suala la mtu binafsi lichunguzwe kwa mujibu wa sheria.

en.text: English translation pending review. Original answer: Hapana. Tajnisi inahitaji maombi na kutimiza masharti. Jedwali la Pili linataja ukaazi katika miezi 12 kabla ya maombi na jumla ya angalau miaka saba katika kipindi cha miaka kumi kinachotangulia miezi hiyo 12, pamoja na masharti mengine. Suala la mtu binafsi lichunguzwe kwa mujibu wa sheria.

q.sw: Hatua za kuomba uraia wa tajnisi ni zipi?
q.en: What is the naturalisation procedure?

steps: Jaza fomu za maombi (zinapatikana ofisi za Uhamiaji za Wilaya, Mkoa na Makao Makuu).
Wasilisha kwa Afisa Mtendaji wa Kata au Sheha (Zanzibar), atakayepeleka faili Ofisi ya Uhamiaji ya Wilaya.
Lipa ada ya uwasilishaji ya USD 1,500 (hairudishwi).
Tangaza nia yako ya kuomba uraia kwenye matoleo mawili mfululizo ya magazeti ya kila siku yaliyosajiliwa, Tanzania Bara na Zanzibar.
Hudhuria mahojiano ya Kamati ya Ulinzi na Usalama ya Wilaya.
Ombi hupelekwa Kamati ya Ulinzi na Usalama ya Mkoa, kisha kwa Kamishna Jenerali wa Uhamiaji kwa mapendekezo.
Kamishna Jenerali huwasilisha kwa Waziri, ambaye ndiye hufanya uamuzi wa mwisho.
sw.note: Kwa Zanzibar, Kamishna wa Uhamiaji Zanzibar hupeleka kwanza ombi Ofisi ya Makamu wa Pili wa Rais kwa mapendekezo kabla ya kufika kwa Kamishna Jenerali.

steps: Fill in the application forms (available at District, Regional and Headquarters immigration offices).
Submit to the Ward Executive Officer or Sheha (Zanzibar), who forwards the file to the District Immigration Office.
Pay the non-refundable submission fee of USD 1,500.
Publish your notice of intention to apply in two consecutive issues of registered daily newspapers, Mainland and Zanzibar.
Attend an interview by the District Defence and Security Committee.
The application goes to the Regional Defence and Security Committee, then to the Commissioner General for recommendation.
The Commissioner General submits it to the Minister, who makes the final decision.
en.note: In Zanzibar, the Commissioner of Immigration Zanzibar first sends it to the Office of the Second Vice President for recommendation.

q.sw: Ndoa na Mtanzania inanipa uraia moja kwa moja?
q.en: How does a woman married to a Tanzanian get citizenship?

aliases: Ndoa na Mtanzania inanipa uraia moja kwa moja?

sw.text: Hapana. Lazima kufuatwe utaratibu wa maombi na masharti ya sheria. Kifungu cha 11 katika Sheria ya Uraia iliyotolewa kina utaratibu maalumu kwa mwanamke aliyeolewa na raia wa Tanzania; kisielezwe kuwa kinawapa wanandoa wote uraia moja kwa moja.

en.text: English translation pending review. Original answer: Hapana. Lazima kufuatwe utaratibu wa maombi na masharti ya sheria. Kifungu cha 11 katika Sheria ya Uraia iliyotolewa kina utaratibu maalumu kwa mwanamke aliyeolewa na raia wa Tanzania; kisielezwe kuwa kinawapa wanandoa wote uraia moja kwa moja.

q.sw: Mtoto wa raia anapataje uraia wa tajnisi?
q.en: How does a citizen's child get naturalised?

sw.text: Waziri anaweza kumpa uraia mtoto (chini ya miaka 18) wa raia wa Tanzania baada ya mzazi au mlezi kuwasilisha ombi.
steps: Mzazi/mlezi hujaza fomu maalum.
Huwasilisha Ofisi ya Uhamiaji ya Wilaya, Mkoa, Afisi Kuu Zanzibar au Makao Makuu, na kulipa USD 1,500 (hairudishwi).
Ombi hupelekwa kwa Kamishna Jenerali kwa mapendekezo, kisha kwa Waziri kwa uamuzi.
sw.note: Mzazi/mlezi lazima awe raia na athibitishe uraia wake. Viambatisho: uthibitisho wa uraia wa mzazi/mlezi, cheti cha kuzaliwa cha mtoto, hadhi halali ya kiuhamiaji ya mtoto na picha 5 za pasipoti.

en.text: The Minister may naturalise the minor child (under 18) of a Tanzanian citizen upon application by a parent or guardian.
steps: The parent/guardian fills in the forms.
Submits at a District, Regional, Zanzibar Head Office or Headquarters immigration office and pays USD 1,500 (non-refundable).
The application goes to the Commissioner General, then to the Minister for decision.
en.note: The parent/guardian must be a citizen and prove it. Documents: proof of the parent's citizenship, the child's birth certificate, the child's valid immigration status and 5 passport photos.

q.sw: Ada za uraia ni kiasi gani?
q.en: How much are citizenship fees?

list: Ombi la uraia wa tajnisi (mgeni, mke wa raia au mtoto): USD 1,500 — ada ya uwasilishaji, hairudishwi.
Kukana uraia wa Tanzania: USD 60.
Naturalisation application (foreigner, citizen's wife or minor): USD 1,500 — non-refundable submission fee.
Renunciation of Tanzanian citizenship: USD 60.

q.en: Does Tanzania allow dual citizenship?

q.sw: Ninakanaje uraia wa Tanzania?
q.en: How do I renounce Tanzanian citizenship?

sw.text: Raia mwenye umri wa miaka 18 na akili timamu anaweza kukana uraia kwa kutoa tamko rasmi linalosajiliwa na Waziri.
steps: Jaza fomu maalum.
Wasilisha Ofisi ya Uhamiaji au Ubalozi/Ofisi ya Kibalozi unakoishi, au kwa Kamishna Jenerali wa Uhamiaji.
Kamishna Jenerali hupeleka ombi kwa Waziri, anayesajili tamko.
sw.note: Viambatisho: uthibitisho wa kupewa uraia wa nchi nyingine, kurudisha pasipoti ya Tanzania, picha 5 za pasipoti na ada ya USD 60. Waziri anaweza kukataa kusajili tamko wakati wa vita au kama ni kinyume na sera ya umma.

en.text: A citizen aged 18+ of full capacity may renounce citizenship by a formal declaration registered by the Minister.
steps: Fill in the prescribed forms.
Submit at an Immigration Office or the Embassy/High Commission where you live, or to the Commissioner General.
The Commissioner General forwards it to the Minister, who registers the declaration.
en.note: Documents: proof of grant of the other citizenship, return of the Tanzanian passport, 5 passport photos and a USD 60 fee. The Minister may refuse registration during war or if against public policy.

group.sw: Uraia pacha, kukana na kupoteza uraia

q.sw: Raia wa tajnisi anaweza kunyang'anywa uraia kwa sababu gani?
q.en: When can a naturalised citizen be deprived of citizenship?

sw.text: Waziri anaweza kumnyang'anya uraia raia wa tajnisi pale ambapo:
list: Cheti cha uraia kilipatikana kwa udanganyifu, taarifa za uongo au kuficha ukweli muhimu.
Ameonyesha kwa vitendo au maneno kutokuwa mtiifu kwa Jamhuri ya Muungano.
Wakati wa vita alishirikiana au kufanya biashara na adui kinyume cha sheria.
Ndani ya miaka 5 tangu apewe uraia amehukumiwa kifungo cha miezi 12 au zaidi katika nchi yoyote.
Ameishi nje ya nchi kwa miaka 5 mfululizo bila kujisajili kila mwaka ubalozini au kumjulisha Waziri nia ya kubaki raia.
sw.note: Kabla ya uamuzi, mhusika hupewa taarifa ya maandishi na haki ya kuomba uchunguzi mbele ya Kamati ya Uchunguzi. Raia kwa kuzaliwa hanyang'anywi uraia kwa sababu hizi.

en.text: The Minister may deprive a naturalised citizen of citizenship where:
list: The certificate was obtained by fraud, false representation or concealment of material facts.
The person has shown disloyalty to the United Republic by act or speech.
During war, the person unlawfully traded or communicated with the enemy.
Within 5 years of naturalisation, the person was sentenced anywhere to 12 months' imprisonment or more.
The person lived abroad for 5 continuous years without registering annually at a consulate or notifying the Minister.
en.note: Before an order, the person receives written notice and may request an inquiry by a Committee. Citizens by birth are not deprived on these grounds.

q.sw: Nani anaamua ombi la uraia, na nini hufuata likikubaliwa?
q.en: Who decides, and what happens after approval?

list: Maombi hujadiliwa na Kamati za Ulinzi na Usalama (Kata/Shehia, Wilaya, Mkoa), kisha Kamishna Jenerali wa Uhamiaji hutoa mapendekezo.
Waziri mwenye dhamana ya uraia (Waziri wa Mambo ya Ndani ya Nchi) ndiye mwenye mamlaka ya mwisho.
Ukiarifiwa kuwa ombi limekubaliwa, ndani ya siku 28 lazima ukane uraia wa nchi nyingine, ule kiapo cha utii na uwasilishe ushahidi — vinginevyo ombi hufutwa.
Ukitimiza hayo unakuwa raia wa tajnisi kuanzia tarehe ya kupewa uraia na hupewa cheti cha uraia (certificate of naturalisation).
Applications are reviewed by Defence and Security Committees (Ward/Shehia, District, Region), then the Commissioner General recommends.
The Minister responsible for citizenship (Home Affairs) has final authority.
Once notified of approval, within 28 days you must renounce other citizenship, take the oath of allegiance and submit proof — otherwise the application is quashed.
You then become a citizen by naturalisation from the date of grant and receive a certificate of naturalisation.

group.sw: Uraia pacha, kukana na kupoteza uraia

q.sw: Mtoto mwenye uraia wa nchi mbili afanye nini akifikisha miaka 18?
q.en: What must a dual-citizen child do at 18?

steps: Aukane uraia wa nchi nyingine.
Ale kiapo cha utii kwa Jamhuri ya Muungano.
Kama ni raia kwa kurithi, atoe tamko rasmi la nia yake ya ukaazi.
sw.note: Asipofanya hivyo, atakoma kuwa raia wa Tanzania pale atakapozidi umri wa miaka 18. Kama sheria ya nchi nyingine haimruhusu kukana, anaweza kutoa tamko maalum badala yake.

steps: Renounce the other citizenship.
Take the oath of allegiance to the United Republic.
If a citizen by descent, make a declaration of intention as to residence.
en.note: Otherwise they cease to be Tanzanian after turning 18. If the other country does not allow renunciation, a special declaration may be made instead.

group.sw: Uraia pacha, kukana na kupoteza uraia

q.sw: Mwanamke aliyekana uraia kwa kuolewa na mgeni, ndoa ikivunjika anaweza kurudia uraia?
q.en: Can a woman who renounced citizenship on marrying a foreigner regain it?

sw.text: Ndiyo. Mwanamke aliye raia wa Tanzania kwa kuzaliwa aliyekana uraia wake alipoolewa na raia wa nchi nyingine, ndoa hiyo ikivunjika, anaweza kurejea kwenye uraia wake wa kuzaliwa kwa masharti yatakayowekwa na Waziri kwa kanuni.

en.text: Yes. A Tanzanian citizen by birth who renounced her citizenship on marrying a foreign national may, if the marriage breaks down, revert to citizenship by birth on conditions set by the Minister in regulations.

group.sw: Uraia pacha, kukana na kupoteza uraia

q.sw: Raia anaweza kupoteza uraia kwa kutumia haki za raia wa nchi nyingine?
q.en: Can a citizen lose citizenship for using another country's citizen rights?

aliases: haki za raia wa nchi nyingine

sw.text: Ndiyo, kwa raia asiye wa kuzaliwa. Waziri anaweza kumnyang'anya uraia mtu (isipokuwa raia kwa kuzaliwa) ambaye, akiwa na umri wa miaka 18 na zaidi, amedai na kutumia kwa hiari katika nchi ya kigeni haki inayotolewa kwa raia wa nchi hiyo pekee, na ikiwa si kwa manufaa ya umma aendelee kuwa raia.

en.text: Yes, for citizens not by birth. The Minister may deprive a person (other than a citizen by birth) who, as an adult, voluntarily claimed and exercised in a foreign country a right reserved for that country's citizens, if continued citizenship is not conducive to the public good.

q.sw: Mjue Jirani Yako inamaanisha nini?
q.en: What does "Know Your Neighbour" mean?

sw.text: Ni mwito kwa kila mwananchi kuwafahamu watu wanaoishi na kufanya kazi karibu naye, na kushirikiana na Idara ya Uhamiaji kudhibiti uhamiaji haramu. Kwa vitendo, mwananchi anatakiwa:
list: Kutowahifadhi, kutowasafirisha wala kutowaajiri wageni wasio na vibali halali.
Kuwahoji na kuwaarifu viongozi wa mtaa/kijiji anapoona mgeni mpya asiyejulikana hali yake ya kiuhamiaji.
Kutoa taarifa Ofisi ya Uhamiaji iliyo karibu, kwa uongozi wa kijiji/mtaa au Polisi pale anapomtilia shaka mgeni.
Kutambua kuwa kuoa au kuolewa na Mtanzania peke yake hakumpi mgeni haki ya kuishi nchini.
sw.note: Idara ya Uhamiaji huendesha elimu kwa umma, misako na doria kwa kushirikiana na vyombo vingine vya ulinzi na wananchi, na imeanzisha madaftari ya kuandikisha wageni hasa katika mikoa ya mipakani.

en.text: A call for every citizen to know the people living and working around them, and to work with the Immigration Department against illegal immigration. In practice, citizens should:
list: Not harbour, transport or employ foreigners without valid permits.
Inform street/village leaders about new foreigners whose immigration status is unknown.
Report suspicions to the nearest Immigration Office, village/street leaders or the Police.
Understand that marrying a Tanzanian alone does not give a foreigner the right to stay.
en.note: The Department runs public education, operations and patrols with other security organs and the public, and keeps registers of foreigners especially in border regions.

q.sw: Nitoe wapi taarifa ya mgeni ninayemtilia shaka?
q.en: Where do I report a suspicious foreigner?

list: Ofisi ya Uhamiaji ya Wilaya au Mkoa iliyo karibu nawe.
Viongozi wa serikali ya mtaa au kijiji (Mwenyekiti, Afisa Mtendaji) au Sheha kwa Zanzibar.
Kituo cha Polisi kilicho karibu.
Barua pepe: info@immigration.go.tz (Zanzibar: proznz@immigration.go.tz).
sw.note: Eleza unachokijua: mahali mgeni anapoishi au kufanya kazi, tangu lini, na sababu ya shaka yako.

list: Your nearest District or Regional Immigration Office.
Street or village government leaders (Chairperson, Executive Officer) or the Sheha in Zanzibar.
The nearest Police station.
Email: info@immigration.go.tz (Zanzibar: proznz@immigration.go.tz).
en.note: Say what you know: where the foreigner lives or works, since when, and why you are suspicious.

q.sw: Je, mgeni akioa au kuolewa na Mtanzania anaruhusiwa kuishi nchini?
q.en: Can I live permanently in Tanzania because I married a Tanzanian?

aliases: Can I live permanently in Tanzania because I married a Tanzanian?

en.text: Marriage does not automatically grant residence or citizenship. Apply for the appropriate immigration status and satisfy its requirements. Citizenship is a separate legal process; the marriage provisions must be assessed under the Citizenship Act.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Marriage does not automatically grant residence or citizenship. Apply for the appropriate immigration status and satisfy its requirements. Citizenship is a separate legal process; the marriage provisions must be assessed under the Citizenship Act.

q.sw: Mhamiaji asiye na hadhi halali anatofautianaje na mgeni wa kawaida?
q.en: Who is an illegal immigrant, and how can citizens help?

aliases: Mhamiaji asiye na hadhi halali anatofautianaje na mgeni wa kawaida?

sw.text: Suala ni kufuata masharti ya kuingia na kuishi nchini. Mtu anaweza kuingia kihalali lakini baadaye kuvunja masharti ya ukaazi. Ugeni, lugha au mwonekano pekee havithibitishi ukiukaji. Taarifa zenye msingi ziwasilishwe kwa Uhamiaji ili zifanyiwe uchunguzi.

en.text: English translation pending review. Original answer: Suala ni kufuata masharti ya kuingia na kuishi nchini. Mtu anaweza kuingia kihalali lakini baadaye kuvunja masharti ya ukaazi. Ugeni, lugha au mwonekano pekee havithibitishi ukiukaji. Taarifa zenye msingi ziwasilishwe kwa Uhamiaji ili zifanyiwe uchunguzi.

q.sw: Mgeni aliyekaa zaidi ya muda wa visa au kibali chake yuko katika hali gani?
q.en: What is the status of a foreigner who overstays?

sw.text: Mgeni aliyeingia kihalali lakini anaendelea kuishi baada ya muda wa visa, pasi au kibali chake kuisha, au anafanya shughuli zisizoruhusiwa na hati yake, anaishi nchini kinyume cha sheria — yaani ni mhamiaji haramu. Anatakiwa kuhalalisha hali yake mara moja kwa kufika Ofisi ya Uhamiaji.

en.text: A foreigner who entered lawfully but stays after their visa, pass or permit expires, or does activities not allowed by their document, is staying unlawfully — an illegal immigrant. They should regularise their status immediately at an Immigration Office.

q.sw: Kwa nini uhamiaji haramu upo, na una madhara gani?
q.en: Why does illegal immigration happen, and what harm does it cause?

sw.text: Sababu kuu ni:
list: Historia — baadhi ya waliokuja kama wakimbizi hawakufuata taratibu au hawakurejea makwao.
Uchumi — soko huria huvutia wanaotafuta maisha bora.
Jiografia — Tanzania ina eneo la takriban km² 954,087 na inapakana na nchi nane, na mipaka mingi ni ya wazi (mawe ya alama, maziwa, mito, milima).
Siasa — amani ya nchi huvutia wanaokimbia machafuko.
Kijamii — mwingiliano wa kikabila na ndoa mipakani, na imani potofu kuwa ndoa humpa mgeni uhalali wa kuishi.
sw.note: Madhara: kuhatarisha usalama wa nchi; kuongezeka kwa uhalifu kama ujambazi, dawa za kulevya, ugaidi na utapeli; kupungua kwa ajira na huduma kwa wananchi; na kuingiza tamaduni zisizofaa.

en.text: Main causes:
list: History — some who came as refugees did not follow procedures or return home.
Economy — the free market attracts people seeking a better life.
Geography — about 954,087 km² bordering eight countries, with largely open borders (beacons, lakes, rivers, hills).
Politics — Tanzania's peace attracts people fleeing conflict.
Social — cross-border kinship and marriages, and the false belief that marriage legalises a foreigner's stay.
en.note: Harms: threats to national security; more crime such as robbery, drugs, terrorism and fraud; fewer jobs and services for citizens; and harmful foreign practices.

q.sw: Idara ya Uhamiaji inakabiliana vipi na uhamiaji haramu?
q.en: How does the Department fight illegal immigration?

list: Kitengo maalum cha Utawala wa Mipaka na Operesheni (Border Management and Operations) kuimarisha udhibiti wa mipaka, misako na doria.
Mafunzo ya udhibiti wa mipaka katika Chuo cha Uhamiaji cha Kikanda, Moshi.
Madaftari maalum ya kuandikisha wageni, hasa mikoa ya mipakani.
Elimu kwa umma na ushiriki wa maafisa katika vikao vya vijiji kuhusu uraia na haki zake.
Misako na doria kwa kushirikiana na vyombo vingine vya ulinzi na usalama na wananchi.
Kuunganisha ofisi za mipakani, wilaya na mikoa kwa mtandao wa kompyuta.
A Border Management and Operations unit for border control, operations and patrols.
Border management training at the Regional Immigration Training Academy, Moshi.
Registers of foreigners, especially in border regions.
Public education and officers' participation in village meetings on citizenship and rights.
Joint operations and patrols with other security organs and the public.
Networking border, district and regional offices by computer.

q.sw: Je, mgeni anaweza kufanya kazi Tanzania bila kibali?
q.en: Can a foreigner work in Tanzania without a permit?

aliases: adhabu ya kuajiri mgeni bila kibali
mgeni anaweza kufanya kazi bila kibali

sw.text: Hapana. Mgeni haruhusiwi kufanya kazi yoyote — ya malipo, faida au hata isiyo ya faida — bila:
list: Kibali cha Kazi (Work Permit) halali kinachoruhusu kazi hiyo, kutoka kwa Kamishna wa Kazi; au
Cheti cha Msamaha (Certificate of Exemption) halali.
Mwajiri anatakiwa kuomba Kibali cha Kazi kabla mgeni hajaingia nchini, kisha kibali cha ukaazi kinachohusika (mf. Class B).
sw.note: Kumwajiri au kufanya kazi bila kibali ni kosa: adhabu ni faini isiyopungua Tsh milioni 10, au kifungo kisichopungua miaka 2, au vyote viwili — kwa mgeni na kwa mwajiri.

en.text: No. A foreigner may not engage in any occupation — paid, for profit or even non-profit — without:
list: A valid Work Permit from the Labour Commissioner allowing that occupation; or
A valid Certificate of Exemption.
The employer must apply for the Work Permit before the foreigner enters, then the relevant residence permit (e.g. Class B).
en.note: Working or employing without a permit is an offence: a fine of not less than Tsh 10 million, or imprisonment of not less than 2 years, or both — for both the foreigner and the employer.

q.sw: Je, ni kosa kumhifadhi, kumsafirisha au kumwajiri mhamiaji haramu?
q.en: Is it an offence to harbour, transport or employ an illegal immigrant?

list: Ndiyo. Kuwahifadhi au kuwasafirisha wahamiaji haramu kwa manufaa binafsi ni kinyume cha sheria za uhamiaji na huchukuliwa hatua za kisheria.
Kumwajiri mgeni asiye na Kibali cha Kazi au Cheti cha Msamaha ni kosa: faini isiyopungua Tsh milioni 10, au kifungo kisichopungua miaka 2, au vyote.
Usafirishaji haramu wa binadamu (migrant trafficking) ni kosa kubwa, na mhusika anaweza hata kufutiwa pasipoti yake.
Yes. Harbouring or transporting illegal immigrants for personal gain is against immigration law and attracts legal action.
Employing a foreigner without a Work Permit or Certificate of Exemption is an offence: a fine of not less than Tsh 10 million, or at least 2 years' imprisonment, or both.
Migrant trafficking is a serious offence and can also lead to revocation of the offender's passport.

q.sw: Mgeni mwenye visa ya utalii au Visitor's Pass anaruhusiwa kufanya kazi au biashara?
q.en: May I start a job using a tourist visa while waiting for my permits?

aliases: May I start a job using a tourist visa while waiting for my permits?

en.text: A tourism visa does not authorise employment. Obtain the authorisations required for your intended work and residence before starting the job. A pending application, employment contract or payment receipt is not itself permission to work.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: A tourism visa does not authorise employment. Obtain the authorisations required for your intended work and residence before starting the job. A pending application, employment contract or payment receipt is not itself permission to work.

q.sw: Ni makosa gani ya pasipoti na adhabu zake?
q.en: What are passport offences and their penalties?

sw.text: Kwa mujibu wa sheria ya pasipoti, ni kosa:
list: Kutoa taarifa au tamko la uongo ili kupata pasipoti.
Kutumia pasipoti ya mtu mwingine kama yako, au kutoirudisha kwa mwenyewe au kwa Idara.
Kughushi, kubadilisha, kuharibu au kuruhusu pasipoti kughushiwa au kutumika kwa jambo haramu.
Kukutwa na pasipoti ya kughushi au iliyobadilishwa, au zaidi ya pasipoti moja ya aina moja bila idhini.
Kuwasilisha nyaraka za kughushi ili kupata pasipoti.
Kukataa kurudisha pasipoti iliyofutwa, au pasipoti ya kiutumishi/kidiplomasia unapotakiwa.
sw.note: Adhabu: faini ya kati ya Tsh 200,000 na Tsh 1,000,000, au kifungo, au vyote viwili.

en.text: Under the passports law it is an offence to:
list: Make a false statement or declaration to obtain a passport.
Present another person's passport as yours or fail to return it.
Forge, alter, damage or allow a passport to be forged or used unlawfully.
Possess a forged/altered passport, or more than one passport of the same type without authority.
Present forged documents to obtain a passport.
Refuse to return a revoked passport, or a service/diplomatic passport when required.
en.note: Penalty: a fine of Tsh 200,000 to Tsh 1,000,000, or imprisonment, or both.

q.sw: Mtu anayetafuta hifadhi afuate utaratibu gani?
q.en: What rules apply to refugees and asylum seekers?

aliases: Mtu anayetafuta hifadhi afuate utaratibu gani?

sw.text: Sheria ya Wakimbizi inaelekeza anayefika nchini na kutaka kutambuliwa kama mkimbizi kujitokeza au kuripoti kwa mamlaka iliyotajwa bila kuchelewa, kwa kawaida ndani ya siku saba, isipokuwa awe na sababu inayokubalika ya kuchelewa. Aliye nchini kihalali na baadaye kushindwa kurudi kwa sababu zinazotambuliwa aripoti kabla ya ukaazi wake kuisha.

q.sw: Masharti ya kuingia Tanzania ni yapi?
q.en: What are the requirements to enter Tanzania?

sw.text: Kila msafiri — raia, mkaazi au mgeni — lazima aingie kupitia vituo rasmi vya kuingilia. Ukifika:
list: Fika mbele ya Afisa Uhamiaji ukiwa na kadi ya kuwasili (arrival declaration card) iliyojazwa na kusainiwa.
Onyesha pasipoti au hati nyingine inayokubalika.
Mgeni anaweza kutakiwa kuonyesha visa (au kuiomba akifika), kibali/pasi ya ukaazi kama ni mkaazi, tiketi ya kurudi au ya kuendelea na safari, na ushahidi wa fedha za kujikimu.
sw.note: Zingatia pia miongozo ya afya ya Wizara ya Afya (mf. chanjo ya homa ya manjano).

en.text: Every traveller — citizen, resident or foreigner — must enter through designated entry points. On arrival:
list: Appear before an Immigration Officer with a completed and signed arrival declaration card.
Present your passport or other acceptable document.
Foreigners may be asked for a visa (or apply on arrival), residence permit/pass if resident, return or onward ticket, and proof of funds.
en.note: Also observe Ministry of Health guidelines (e.g. yellow fever vaccination).

q.en: Which Immigration services are online?

q.en: Are Ethiopian nationals automatically referral visa applicants?

q.en: Do old referral instructions for Azerbaijan and Sri Lanka still apply?

q.sw: What is the difference between nationality and country of residence?
q.en: What is the difference between nationality and country of residence?

aliases: What is the difference between nationality and country of residence?

en.text: Nationality is your citizenship; country of residence is where you live. Enter each accurately. A residence permit from another country does not make you a citizen of that country. If the form does not offer the correct nationality or travel-document option, request official assistance before submitting.

q.sw: Which visa is appropriate for a meeting or conference?

en.text: Ordinary Visa may cover attending a meeting, conference, workshop or exhibition, subject to nationality rules. Provide an invitation explaining your role. If you will perform paid services, technical work or another assignment, disclose this so the appropriate business, work or residence authorisation can be identified.

q.sw: Do I need immigration clearance if I leave the airport during a connection?
q.en: Do I need immigration clearance if I leave the airport during a connection?

aliases: Do I need immigration clearance if I leave the airport during a connection?

en.text: Leaving the international transit area may require entry clearance and an appropriate visa or exemption. Confirm this before planning an overnight hotel stay or a visit outside the airport. Airport transit arrangements and nationality must be considered together.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Leaving the international transit area may require entry clearance and an appropriate visa or exemption. Confirm this before planning an overnight hotel stay or a visit outside the airport. Airport transit arrangements and nationality must be considered together.

q.sw: Can I leave Tanzania and return using an Ordinary Visa?
q.en: Can I leave Tanzania and return using an Ordinary Visa?

aliases: Can I leave Tanzania and return using an Ordinary Visa?

en.text: The e-Library guidelines contain a specific provision for return from East African countries while the visa remains valid. Do not treat this as unrestricted multiple entry. Confirm that your itinerary qualifies and that your permission remains valid; departure does not automatically reset your authorised stay.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: The e-Library guidelines contain a specific provision for return from East African countries while the visa remains valid. Do not treat this as unrestricted multiple entry. Confirm that your itinerary qualifies and that your permission remains valid; departure does not automatically reset your authorised stay.

q.sw: Can I travel with a different passport from the one used to apply?
q.en: Can I travel with a different passport from the one used to apply?

aliases: Can I travel with a different passport from the one used to apply?

en.text: The passport details used for the visa should match the passport presented for immigration clearance. If your passport has been replaced, or you intend to use a second nationality, request official guidance before travel. Do not assume that a visa transfers automatically between passports.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: The passport details used for the visa should match the passport presented for immigration clearance. If your passport has been replaced, or you intend to use a second nationality, request official guidance before travel. Do not assume that a visa transfers automatically between passports.

q.sw: What documents are usually needed for an Ordinary Visa?
q.en: What documents are usually needed for an Ordinary Visa?

aliases: What documents are usually needed for an Ordinary Visa?

en.text: Prepare your passport biographic page, a suitable recent photograph, return travel evidence and any additional documents required by the selected category. Complete the online form accurately. The live portal’s requirements should be checked before submission.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Prepare your passport biographic page, a suitable recent photograph, return travel evidence and any additional documents required by the selected category. Complete the online form accurately. The live portal’s requirements should be checked before submission.

q.sw: May I submit an itinerary instead of a purchased ticket?
q.en: May I submit an itinerary instead of a purchased ticket?

aliases: May I submit an itinerary instead of a purchased ticket?

en.text: The e-Library guidelines expressly allow referral applicants to upload an itinerary while awaiting approval and advise them against paying for bookings beforehand. Other applicants should follow their category’s current requirements. Visitors must be ready to provide return travel evidence on arrival.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: The e-Library guidelines expressly allow referral applicants to upload an itinerary while awaiting approval and advise them against paying for bookings beforehand. q.sw: What should I enter for my host or accommodation?
q.en: What should I enter for my host or accommodation?

aliases: What should I enter for my host or accommodation?

en.text: Enter the genuine host, hotel or other accommodation and accurate contact details requested by the form. If travelling independently, use the option applicable to your situation. Do not invent a host or copy unrelated addresses just to complete a mandatory field.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Enter the genuine host, hotel or other accommodation and accurate contact details requested by the form. If travelling independently, use the option applicable to your situation. Do not invent a host or copy unrelated addresses just to complete a mandatory field.

q.sw: What does nearest embassy mean?
q.en: What does nearest embassy mean?

en.text: It means the Tanzanian embassy or mission closest to where you are applying from. Applicants may be asked to attend an interview where required. Selecting a mission does not mean that your application has been approved or that the mission must issue the visa.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: It means the Tanzanian embassy or mission closest to where you are applying from. Applicants may be asked to attend an interview where required. Selecting a mission does not mean that your application has been approved or that the mission must issue the visa.

q.sw: My intended entry point is missing from the form. What should I do?
q.en: My intended entry point is missing from the form. What should I do?

aliases: My intended entry point is missing from the form. What should I do?

en.text: Ask official visa support how to record your actual route before submitting. Provide the entry point, nationality, travel date and application reference if available. Do not select an unrelated entry point and assume that clearance is guaranteed.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Ask official visa support how to record your actual route before submitting. Provide the entry point, nationality, travel date and application reference if available. Do not select an unrelated entry point and assume that clearance is guaranteed.

q.sw: I entered an incorrect name passport number or nationality. Can I edit it?
q.en: I entered an incorrect name passport number or nationality. Can I edit it?

aliases: I entered an incorrect name passport number or nationality. Can I edit it?

en.text: The e-Library guidelines state that submitted visa applications cannot be modified by the applicant. Contact Immigration with your Application ID, the incorrect detail and the correct supporting document. Follow the official advice on correction or a new application; do not rely on an assurance that the error will be ignored at the border.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: The e-Library guidelines state that submitted visa applications cannot be modified by the applicant. Contact Immigration with your Application ID, the incorrect detail and the correct supporting document. Follow the official advice on correction or a new application; do not rely on an assurance that the error will be ignored at the border.

q.sw: My flight dates changed after my visa was issued. What should I do?
q.en: My flight dates changed after my visa was issued. What should I do?

aliases: My flight dates changed after my visa was issued. What should I do?

en.text: Send the revised itinerary and Visa Grant Notice to official visa support before travelling and request guidance. A date change does not automatically extend a visa or the permitted stay. Do not alter the notice yourself.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Send the revised itinerary and Visa Grant Notice to official visa support before travelling and request guidance. A date change does not automatically extend a visa or the permitted stay. Do not alter the notice yourself.

q.sw: Can I use an invitation letter in every attachment field?
q.en: Can I use an invitation letter in every attachment field?

aliases: Can I use an invitation letter in every attachment field?

en.text: Upload the document requested in each field. An invitation letter does not normally replace a passport, registration certificate, contract or other required evidence. If a document is unavailable or the field appears incorrect, request guidance rather than submitting misleading attachments.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Upload the document requested in each field. An invitation letter does not normally replace a passport, registration certificate, contract or other required evidence. q.sw: My visa is approved but I did not receive the email. What should I do?
q.en: My visa is approved but I did not receive the email. What should I do?

aliases: My visa is approved but I did not receive the email. What should I do?

en.text: Check the application status through the official portal and download the Visa Grant Notice if available. Check your email’s junk folder. If the download fails, provide your Application ID and a description of the problem through the official support channel.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Check the application status through the official portal and download the Visa Grant Notice if available. Check your email’s junk folder. If the download fails, provide your Application ID and a description of the problem through the official support channel.

q.sw: Can I travel while my online visa is still pending?
q.en: Can I travel while my online visa is still pending?

aliases: Can I travel while my online visa is still pending?

en.text: The e-Library guidelines advise applicants to wait for approval before beginning their journey. A pending application or payment receipt is not a Visa Grant Notice. If travel is urgent, seek case-specific guidance; referral applicants must have the required prior approval.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: The e-Library guidelines advise applicants to wait for approval before beginning their journey. A pending application or payment receipt is not a Visa Grant Notice. If travel is urgent, seek case-specific guidance; referral applicants must have the required prior approval.

q.sw: When should a referral applicant apply?
q.en: When should a referral applicant apply?

aliases: When should a referral applicant apply?

en.text: The e-Library guidelines advise applying at least two months before the proposed travel date and waiting for approval. This is a planning lead time, not a promise of approval within two months. Do not make non-refundable travel or accommodation payments before the necessary approval.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: The e-Library guidelines advise applying at least two months before the proposed travel date and waiting for approval. This is a planning lead time, not a promise of approval within two months. Do not make non-refundable travel or accommodation payments before the necessary approval.

q.sw: What should a host provide for a referral application?
q.en: What should a host provide for a referral application?

aliases: What should a host provide for a referral application?

en.text: Provide a truthful invitation or request letter identifying the visitor, purpose, planned duration, accommodation and host contacts, with supporting identity or registration documents as required. The e-Library guidelines direct invitation or application letters to the Commissioner General of Immigration. Follow any applicable Zanzibar submission instructions.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Provide a truthful invitation or request letter identifying the visitor, purpose, planned duration, accommodation and host contacts, with supporting identity or registration documents as required. q.sw: Can a tour operator guarantee referral approval?
q.en: Can a tour operator guarantee referral approval?

aliases: Can a tour operator guarantee referral approval?

en.text: No. A registered tour operator may provide genuine host information and supporting documents, but approval rests with Immigration. Do not rely on a promise of a guaranteed visa, special access or a fixed approval date.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: No. A registered tour operator may provide genuine host information and supporting documents, but approval rests with Immigration. Do not rely on a promise of a guaranteed visa, special access or a fixed approval date.

q.sw: I have a refugee travel document issued by a visa free country. Am I exempt?
q.en: I have a refugee travel document issued by a visa free country. Am I exempt?

aliases: I have a refugee travel document issued by a visa free country. Am I exempt?

en.text: Do not assume that the issuing country’s ordinary passport exemption applies to you. The e-Library guidelines place refugee and stateless applicants under prior-clearance requirements. Declare the actual document and status and obtain the required approval before travelling.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Do not assume that the issuing country’s ordinary passport exemption applies to you. The e-Library guidelines place refugee and stateless applicants under prior-clearance requirements. Declare the actual document and status and obtain the required approval before travelling.

q.sw: Which payment method should I use?
q.en: Which payment method should I use?

aliases: Which payment method should I use?

en.text: Use only a payment method currently offered on the official application portal or the official bill for your application. The e-Library Visa Guidelines identify Visa Card and Mastercard. Do not use bank account details from an old email or make an unrequested transfer.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Use only a payment method currently offered on the official application portal or the official bill for your application. The e-Library Visa Guidelines identify Visa Card and Mastercard. Do not use bank account details from an old email or make an unrequested transfer.

q.sw: My card payment was declined. What should I do?
q.en: My card payment was declined. What should I do?

aliases: My card payment was declined. What should I do?

en.text: Check the error message and consult your bank about online international payments and any required authentication. You may try another authorised card if the portal allows it. If the problem continues, send official support your application reference and an error screenshot with sensitive card information hidden.

q.sw: My bank shows a debit but the portal says unpaid. Should I pay again?
q.en: My bank shows a debit but the portal says unpaid. Should I pay again?

aliases: My bank shows a debit but the portal says unpaid. Should I pay again?

en.text: First establish whether the debit is pending or settled and request payment tracing. Provide the Application ID, payment reference, date, amount and suitably redacted receipt through the official support channel. Avoid repeated payments until the transaction has been checked.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: First establish whether the debit is pending or settled and request payment tracing. Provide the Application ID, payment reference, date, amount and suitably redacted receipt through the official support channel. Avoid repeated payments until the transaction has been checked.

q.sw: I appear to have been charged twice. How do I report it?
q.en: I appear to have been charged twice. How do I report it?

aliases: I appear to have been charged twice. How do I report it?

en.text: Ask your bank whether both transactions settled, then submit the references, dates, amounts and redacted evidence to official support. Request reconciliation of the payment records. A duplicate debit must be investigated; neither a refund nor a finding that the bank is responsible should be promised before verification.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Ask your bank whether both transactions settled, then submit the references, dates, amounts and redacted evidence to official support. Request reconciliation of the payment records. A duplicate debit must be investigated; neither a refund nor a finding that the bank is responsible should be promised before verification.

q.sw: My payment bill expired. What should I do?
q.en: My payment bill expired. What should I do?

aliases: My payment bill expired. What should I do?

en.text: Check the application status and request current instructions on obtaining a valid payment reference or starting another application. Do not pay against an expired bill or reuse another applicant’s reference. If money has already been debited, request tracing before making another payment.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Check the application status and request current instructions on obtaining a valid payment reference or starting another application. Do not pay against an expired bill or reuse another applicant’s reference. If money has already been debited, request tracing before making another payment.

q.sw: Can I pay for my whole family using one application reference?
q.en: Can I pay for my whole family using one application reference?

aliases: Can I pay for my whole family using one application reference?

en.text: Keep each applicant’s bill and reference separate and follow the payment options offered by the portal. Do not combine payments under one reference unless the current official system explicitly supports that arrangement. Each visa application must be submitted individually.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Keep each applicant’s bill and reference separate and follow the payment options offered by the portal. Do not combine payments under one reference unless the current official system explicitly supports that arrangement. Each visa application must be submitted individually.

q.sw: What information should I provide when reporting a technical problem?
q.en: What information should I provide when reporting a technical problem?

aliases: What information should I provide when reporting a technical problem?

en.text: State the service, Application ID if available, step where the error occurred, date and time, browser and error message. Include a screenshot with unnecessary personal information hidden. Never send a password, one-time code, PIN or full card details.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: State the service, Application ID if available, step where the error occurred, date and time, browser and error message. q.sw: May another person help me fill in the application?
q.en: May another person help me fill in the application?

aliases: May another person help me fill in the application?

en.text: You may obtain assistance, but check every detail before submission and retain access to your application and notifications. Private assistance is not official approval or an Immigration agency relationship. Use the official portal and distinguish government fees from any private service charges.
