q.sw: Are Business Visa and Business Pass the same document?
q.en: Are Business Visa and Business Pass the same document?

aliases: Are Business Visa and Business Pass the same document?

en.text: No. Business Visa and Business Pass are separate authorisations. Business Pass is relevant to eligible persons from visa-exempt countries carrying out temporary business or professional assignments. Check the correct route, including the specific EAC Special Pass category where applicable.

Business Pass is relevant to eligible persons from visa-exempt countries carrying out temporary business or professional assignments. Check the correct route, including the specific EAC Special Pass category where applicable.

q.sw: Can an EAC national work simply because a visa is not required?
q.en: Can an EAC national work simply because a visa is not required?

aliases: Can an EAC national work simply because a visa is not required?

en.text: Visa exemption does not itself authorise employment or professional assignments. The regulations provide a Special Pass for East African Community Partner States for eligible activities. Ask Immigration to assess the activity and duration, and obtain any applicable labour or professional authorisation.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: Visa exemption does not itself authorise employment or professional assignments. The regulations provide a Special Pass for East African Community Partner States for eligible activities. Ask Immigration to assess the activity and duration, and obtain any applicable labour or professional authorisation.

q.sw: Is a Special Pass for EAC nationals the same as an Interim Pass?
q.en: Is a Special Pass for EAC nationals the same as an Interim Pass?

aliases: Is a Special Pass for EAC nationals the same as an Interim Pass?

en.text: No. The 2023 immigration amendments distinguish the EAC Special Pass from the Interim Pass. Interim Pass addresses specified temporary immigration formalities or status issues; it should not be described as a general work authorisation. Select the category that matches the actual circumstances.

q.sw: What is the difference between a Work Permit and a Residence Permit?
q.en: What is the difference between a Work Permit and a Residence Permit?

aliases: What is the difference between a Work Permit and a Residence Permit?

en.text: A Work Permit concerns permission to work under the relevant labour framework; a Residence Permit concerns residence under immigration law. One should not be treated as a replacement for the other. For Mainland Tanzania, the supplied employment statute is Cap. 436; Zanzibar labour requirements must be checked separately.

Jibu la asili: A Work Permit concerns permission to work under the relevant labour framework; a Residence Permit concerns residence under immigration law. q.en: Should a Residence Permit be approved before entry?

aliases: Should a Residence Permit be approved before entry?

en.text: The e-Library Residence Permit Guidelines generally require application and approval before entry, with specified exceptions for retired persons and those winding up affairs under Class C. The residence brochure also describes an exception for Class A. Confirm the route for your exact category before travel; being in Tanzania does not itself authorise work or continued stay.

q.sw: Must I submit separate duplicate applications for work and residence permits?
q.en: Must I submit separate duplicate applications for work and residence permits?

aliases: Must I submit separate duplicate applications for work and residence permits?

en.text: For applications covered by the integrated Mainland work and residence system, follow the route stated in the current official guidelines. The e-Library guidelines describe starting through the labour system and subsequent Immigration processing. Do not submit duplicate applications without being instructed to do so.

q.sw: Can I volunteer or undertake an internship on a tourism visa?
q.en: Can I volunteer or undertake an internship on a tourism visa?

aliases: Can I volunteer or undertake an internship on a tourism visa?

en.text: Do not assume that unpaid activity is tourism. Disclose the duties, host institution, location and duration so that the appropriate visa, pass, Residence Permit and any sector or labour approval can be identified. Internship, volunteering and missionary work may have different documentary requirements.

Disclose the duties, host institution, location and duration so that the appropriate visa, pass, Residence Permit and any sector or labour approval can be identified. q.sw: What authorisation does a foreign student need?
q.en: What authorisation does a foreign student need?

aliases: What authorisation does a foreign student need?

en.text: Use the study route appropriate to nationality, course and duration. Student Visa and Student Pass are different authorisations; visa-exempt applicants undertaking studies may need Student Pass. Ask the host institution to supply admission and other required documents before applying.

q.sw: Can a non resident company director use Multiple Visa?
q.en: Can a non resident company director use Multiple Visa?

aliases: Can a non resident company director use Multiple Visa?

This is not a substitute for permission to reside in Tanzania or carry out ongoing employment. Disclose the intended activities accurately.

q.sw: May I change employer or occupation using the same permit?
q.en: May I change employer or occupation using the same permit?

aliases: May I change employer or occupation using the same permit?

en.text: Do not assume that the existing permit authorises the new arrangement. Notify the relevant authorities and follow the procedure for variation, cancellation or a new application before starting the new role. Immigration and labour permissions must both be considered.

q.sw: My permitted stay is about to expire. Can I extend it online by applying for another visa?
q.en: My permitted stay is about to expire. Can I extend it online by applying for another visa?

aliases: My permitted stay is about to expire. Can I extend it online by applying for another visa?

en.text: Do not use a new online entry-visa application as an automatic extension of your present stay. Contact the nearest Immigration Office before expiry with your passport, current permission, reasons and supporting evidence. An extension requires an official decision.

q.sw: My permit application is pending. Does that make my stay lawful?
q.en: My permit application is pending. Does that make my stay lawful?

aliases: My permit application is pending. Does that make my stay lawful?

en.text: A pending application does not automatically extend an existing permission. Check the expiry of your current status and ask Immigration whether a specific interim authorisation is appropriate. Comply with the conditions of any pass actually issued.

sw.text: Tafsiri ya Kiswahili inahitaji uhakiki. Jibu la asili: A pending application does not automatically extend an existing permission. q.en: What should I do if I have already overstayed?

aliases: What should I do if I have already overstayed?

en.text: Contact the nearest Immigration Office promptly, explain the circumstances and provide your passport and supporting records. Seek instructions to resolve your status. Do not rely on a fixed fine quoted informally or assume that paying a fee guarantees continued stay.
